api.dependencies: Python 3.9 compatible standard library only; no CLI required

listener_ready.rule: At most once; confirms only that caller recorded listener readiness.

accept.rule: Not already active by object identity. Allocate next never-reused positive connection_id; retain object only while active.

accept_error.rule: No connection allocated; an unsuccessful accept is not an accepted/reset socket.

request.rule: At most one per connection in this HTTP/1.0 probe. Record verbatim; no parsing/normalizing/query/header/body copy. Unsupported fields refuse; oversized path rejects event, marks incomplete, never a truncated exact join.

native.rule: row_index unique globally. Associated event requires prior GET and at most one native event on that connection. wire /api/health or /api/cache-stats MUST use None. Direct rows have connection_id None; do not invent a browser association. No path derivation or native/body verification.

handler_error.rule: Record observation only. No exception object/stringification; no implied parser/path state or physical outcome.

log_error.rule: No arbitrary format/args/raw-request data. Caller later maps known format category; unset path/command attributes are never accessed here.

close.rule: One terminal close observation; release active object reference after retained event. False is valid uncertainty and permanently makes complete false. Does not call close/fileno or independently prove physical close. Later references/duplicate close to the retired object refuse as unknown.

primitive_policy: kind/field names and string field values are exact str; integral fields exact int (bool is rejected); confirmed exact bool; None only where listed; no float/list/dict/bytes/exception fields

Connection is an opaque object, not None/bool/int/float/complex/str/bytes. Never serialize, inspect attributes, call methods, equality, hashing, repr or fileno on it; object identity only. Unhashable opaque fakes are valid.
Unknown kind/extra or missing field/bad type/unknown or invalid connection/order/duplicate is a rejected observation, record returns False and latches first_fault. No coercion or caller mutation.

row_shape.sequence: positive attempted-call ordinal; strictly increasing, may have gaps for rejected calls
row_shape.elapsed_ns: exact nonnegative int from genuine time.monotonic_ns relative to construction; never caller supplied
row_shape.connection_id: None or never-reused monotonic positive int
row_shape.fields: exact fixed field dictionary for kind, copied values

result_shape.complete: exact bool: no first_fault, listener_ready retained exactly once, no active/unconfirmed-close connections at finish
result_shape.first_fault: None or exactly {code: bounded fixed string <=64 ASCII bytes, attempt: nonnegative int}; no arbitrary exception/request text

counts.by_kind: object containing every eight event-kind key and retained count

result_shape.rows: ordered array of exact row_shape objects

state_rules: record is synchronous, in-memory, no callback or failure hook. Ordinary invalid observations return False without throwing, latch bounded first_fault, and leave accepted connection/request/native state unchanged; attempted/rejected still advance. Validation errors can be followed by otherwise valid close observations, while incompleteness stays sticky.

Cap rejection retains the prior rows and terminal incomplete summary; no silent drop or success return. After cap, later calls return False with attempted/rejected counters, without retaining further rows/state changes. Reserve final-envelope headroom or trim only an uncommitted prospective row; finish must always obey the actual full serialized-result cap.

Accepted connection object references exist only in active tracking, never result or rows. Removal releases the reference; a fresh accepted object with a recycled fd or recycled Python id gets a new monotonic connection_id. No fd number is used for association.

Transport accept/handler/log errors are valid observed events, not automatically observer faults. Complete describes evidence accounting, never request success, absence causality, physical closure or renderer readiness.

finish seals once, captures unresolved active counts before releasing active references, and returns a fresh deep copy. Repeated finish returns equal independent deep copies. record after sealing returns False and does not modify the sealed result/counters. No baseline is silently reset.
required_authored_controls: Import/no-action positive; all eight event kinds through public API, exact fields/result/counts/strict JSON.
Distinct opaque/unhashable objects with forbidden attrs/hash/equality/repr; duplicate active accept rejects; fresh object with same fake fd gets distinct id without reading it.
accept_error creates no connection; unknown request/close/native; duplicate request/close/native row index reject without false accepted states; first_fault sticky.
Accepted then close without request is valid and can complete. request/handler/log errors may be absent; no inferred URL/classification.
Confirmed true vs false and missing terminal close distinguish complete/incomplete; close does not invoke fake close or any OS action.
Associated native requires earlier GET; POST-associated native rejects; direct health/cache native rows keep None and do not contribute browser-associated counts.
No path/command/request_version attribute needed for error events; category/error/errno supplied as primitives. Unknown/missing/extra/nonprimitive/nonfinite/equal-bool numeric fields reject.

Row limit and actual complete-result byte limit each exercised with finite authored events; include long multibyte path, final-envelope overhead, sticky cap/rejected counts and bounded finish result. No permissive test if cap was not reached.
Returned first/second finish values deeply independent; mutate nested rows/fields/counts in one returned value and prove later result unchanged; no caller-object mutation; post-finish rejects.
Genuine monotonic nonnegative ordered elapsed times, sequence gaps accounted when observations reject. Test expectations independent literal/invariants, not the implementation private internals.
report_requirements: report task/base, exact source pins, API/identity/limits, actual tests/counts/skips/failures/commands/private evidence; final worker handoff alone carries candidate commit and report own hash (no self-referential report fields)
explicit source-only integration pending, in-memory evidence boundary, timing perturbation/unmeasured overhead, no runtime/client/body/physical-close/readiness/full-game PASS

unchanged original lease/std-lib inputs full pre/post pins; future ROOT owns actual hook return/identical throw/callback/cleanup semantics, native-body/send/worker receipt joins and one fresh fruit probe
future_root_only: Wire selected module into NEW pinned lease copy after implementation comparison. Do not edit old lease/runtime during this task.
Capture after real successful accept; record accept_error then re-raise original OSError; record GET/POST entry only after stdlib parsing.
Native event immediately before actual upstream call uses actual next index and must later match appended upstream row; direct initial/final health/cache calls stay unassociated.
handler_error/log_error must preserve original behavior; no handle_one_request/parse_request/read hooks; unknown parser outcome remains unknown.
